summary: Build conference bids, sponsor plans, and feasibility models in 5 days. Strengthen MICE strategy and business development with practical tools.
lede: MICE strategy and conference business development involves assessing demand, shaping viable conference propositions, and converting opportunities into bookings. Designed for professionals in events, venues, destinations, associations, and commercial roles, the training covers market analysis and opportunity scoring, bid and sponsorship planning, and feasibility budgeting with pipeline and performance reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work in events, venues, destinations, associations, or commercial roles and need a stronger MICE strategy and conference business development toolkit. It suits people responsible for proposal conversion, sponsorship income, event positioning, or performance reporting.
modules: MICE industry strategy and market context
Conference market analysis and opportunity scoring
Conference sales pipeline and bid development
Conference performance reporting and growth strategy
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop with spreadsheet software and enough digital access to work on budgeting, pipeline, and reporting exercises. Familiarity with event proposals, sales calls, sponsor conversations, or venue coordination will help you complete the applied tasks more effectively. A recent conference brief, bid document, or sponsor plan is useful if you want to work on a live business case.
